# Archived LeRobot workflows

GitHub Actions runs workflow files only from `.github/workflows/`. The YAML files in this directory are the original LeRobot workflows, moved here without content changes so this course project does not execute them.

The active workflow is [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](../workflows/ci.yml).

These workflows install simulators, request GPUs, publish Docker images, download checkpoints, publish releases, or read repository secrets. The project CI does not.
